taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA H10 | Hemostasis & Bleeding Disorders.

words.clue: The physiological process of stopping bleeding while maintaining blood fluidity in uninjured vessels
Transient reduction of blood flow following vascular injury through neurogenic and humoral mechanisms
Inner vascular layer that actively maintains an anticoagulant state through production of prostacyclin and nitric oxide
Pro-thrombotic protein found in the subendothelial matrix that initiates platelet adhesion
Anucleate disc-shaped cell that undergoes shape change and aggregation as the foundation of primary hemostasis
Plasma protein that forms bridges between platelets and is cleaved by thrombin to form fibrin
Process of platelet-platelet binding mediated by fibrinogen bridges to GPIIb/IIIa receptors
Cross-linked stable polymer that reinforces the primary platelet plug into a mature thrombus
Series of enzymatic reactions producing massive amplification to form stable fibrin clot
Platelet-derived eicosanoid synthesized from arachidonic acid that amplifies platelet recruitment and activation
Irreversible inhibitor of cyclooxygenase that blocks thromboxane synthesis for the entire platelet lifespan
Release of contents from platelet alpha and dense granules that amplifies the hemostatic response
